meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 把 Flask/Django/FastAPI 的 Python 代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux：缺资源时自动创建资源组、App Service 计划和 Web 应用，设好启动命令并上传代码，部署完成后打印提示信息即结束。
howto.when: 当你说出 “Flask App Service”、“Django App Service” 等关键词，或要求把 Python 代码部署到 App Service 时接管。不适用于 Container Apps、Functions、非 Python 项目。

say.text: 把我的 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: 只需给出应用名，其余参数自动推导

say.text: 这个项目有 azure.yaml，用 azd 部署到 App Service
say.note: 存在 azure.yaml 时走 azd 部署路径

say.text: 帮我把这个 FastAPI 应用部署到 App Service

howto.what_en: Deploys Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux: creates the resource group, plan and web app if missing, sets startup, uploads the code, then prints a post-deploy message.
howto.when_en: Use when you say “Flask App Service”, “Django App Service” or “FastAPI App Service”, or ask to deploy Python code to App Service. Not for Container Apps, Functions, non-Python or IaC.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Only the app name is asked for

say_en.text: This repo has azure.yaml - deploy it to App Service with azd
Deploy this FastAPI app to App Service
say_en.note: Startup set to python -m uvicorn main:app
